settings.title: Fleet sustainability starts with improving fuel efficiency.

settings.editor: Save on fuel and reduce your environmental impact with Smartwatch FM fleet fuel management.

Smartwatch monitors fuel in two ways. For brand new vehicles and trucks, our devices capture fuel data from the vehicle's CANbus system accurately, without drilling the tanks. For vehicles with older technology, we use our reliable fuel sensors to capture the data.
Smartwatch fuel sensors are designed to make accurate measurements of fuel level in vehicle tanks. Based on these measurements, our GPS tracking and telematics platform reports the following data.

Average fuel consumption, e.g. kilometres per litre (km/l)

settings.title: Stop refuelling fraud and fuel theft

settings.editor: Live monitor fuel consumption to counter refuelling fraud and fuel theft. Fuel level change detection sends an alert to the central server when an abnormal event triggers, and the platform detects and records low fuel economy behaviour like harsh driving, route deviation or idling for driver coaching.

Not for newer vehicles, where fuel data is captured accurately from the CANbus system without drilling the tanks. Older vehicles use fuel sensors, including a wireless battery-powered fuel level sensor with 5 to 10 years of battery time and no messing with wires.
Fuel level in the tank of a vehicle, fuel consumption per time period, average fuel consumption (for example kilometres per litre) and fuel refills or drains.
